package.name: harambe_ankle_ethercat_driver
package.description: EtherCAT driver with the EXACT differential-ankle serial-chain kinematics for the Harambe humanoid. Replaces harambe_ethercat_driver: provides both the PVT (CiA 402 mode 5) and CSP/CST hardware_interface plugins, each embedding the closed-form IK / Newton FK eccentric-pushrod model.
